LE_SET_CONFIRM_TEXT: Keep these display settings? Reverting in %SECONDS% s.
LE_SET_WINDOW_MODE_HELP: Window with a frame, borderless window or full screen. Confirm the new mode, or the previous one comes back in 15 seconds.
LE_SET_VSYNC_HELP: Frames follow the monitor refresh: no tearing.
LE_SET_MAX_FPS_HELP: Draw at most this many frames per second: lower keeps a laptop quieter and cooler.
LE_SET_SCALING_HELP: Sharp keeps lines one weight at any window size; integer is pixel for pixel with a frame; classic is fractional nearest neighbour.
LE_SET_BANNERS_HELP: The owner's banner over every party on the map.
LE_SET_AMBIENT_HELP: Volume of map places: mines, cities, forests.
LE_SET_INTRO_HELP: Play the intro movie when the game starts.
LE_SET_QUEUE_STRIP_HELP: Portraits over the battlefield: who moves this round and the next.
LE_SET_LANGUAGE_HELP: Language of the interface. Scenario texts in Russian exist only if the import was given the Russian localisation.
LE_SET_BIND_HELP: Click or press Enter on a binding, then press a new key (or gamepad button). Esc cancels, Backspace clears. The same key is removed from other actions of these screens.
